name: Image Display
body: ## New: Image Display Show images on your GoGo Board's screen — photos, drawings, icons, or anything you like! Upload your own or pick from the built-in gallery, then display them from the web app or in your code. - Preview any image instantly from the **Image Gallery** - Use the new **`show image`** block in your programs - Upload, crop, and rotate your own images > Requires **firmware v3.2.4 or newer** and a **Wi-Fi connection**. 📖 [Read the full guide →](https://arnans.github.io/gogodoc/image-display/image-display.html)
